title: XGBoost predicts need for oxygen therapy in early COVID-19 in Japan
summary: The best of seven machine learning models, XGBoost, used routine data from 396 patients; internal c-statistic was 0.92 versus 0.69 for A-DROP. On a temporal external set of 728 patients it reached 0.88 versus 0.69. The study is retrospective across 11 hospitals in one prefecture early in the pandemic.
ai_technology: XGBoost selected among seven ML models

evidence.tested: Temporal external validation set (n = 728) and 20% internal test set.

source_review.scope: Abstract and Europe PMC full-text Methods/Results excerpts read. Publisher version not otherwise accessed. Author affiliations from OpenAlex metadata.
